svg.title: Creating a new email and editing an existing draft
svg.desc: A new draft request researches contacts if needed, writes and reviews, then saves a Gmail draft. An existing-draft edit reads and revises the message, waits for owner approval, then updates the same draft; rejection leaves it unchanged. The owner sends manually in Gmail.
